hero.title: Create space for clarity, growth, and meaningful change.

whoThisIsFor.title: Coaching for moments that call for clarity and growth.
whoThisIsFor.description: This work is designed for people who want to better understand where they are, where they want to go, and what may be standing in the way.
whoThisIsFor.imageAlt: A notebook and pen beside a sunlit window, ready for reflection.
whoThisIsFor.reflection: You do not need to have it all figured out to begin.

professionals.title: Professionals
professionals.description: For professionals who want to grow with greater confidence, focus, and purpose.

leaders.title: Leaders
leaders.description: For leaders navigating responsibility, relationships, communication, and change.

transition.title: People in Transition
transition.description: For those moving through career shifts, new roles, or important personal decisions.

clarity.title: Those Seeking Clarity
clarity.description: For anyone who feels stuck, uncertain, or ready to explore a different way forward.

whatToExpect.title: Space to think. Support to move forward.
whatToExpect.description: Coaching is a conversation with purpose. It offers time to step back, look at things differently, and understand what matters most to you.
whatToExpect.approach: You bring what is on your mind. Together, we explore it through thoughtful questions, honest reflection, and practical next steps.
whatToExpect.focus: The work is shaped around your goals, your pace, and your context. We make room to notice patterns, explore assumptions, and turn greater awareness into intentional steps in your life and work.
whatToExpect.imageAlt: An overhead view of two people sharing a conversation around a table with a notebook and cups.

process.title: A starting point, shaped around you.
process.description: Every coaching relationship begins with a conversation. From there, we find a focus and a way of working that makes sense for your goals.

discovery.title: Start with a conversation
discovery.description: Share what brings you here, ask your questions, and explore whether coaching feels like the right fit.

direction.title: Choose a direction together
direction.description: Clarify what you want to work toward and discuss an approach that fits your priorities and circumstances.

sessions.title: Make space for the work
sessions.description: Use focused conversations to reflect, challenge familiar patterns, and identify meaningful steps forward.

progress.title: Reflect on what comes next
progress.description: Notice what is changing, review what you are learning, and decide together where to go from here.

invitation.title: Your next step can start with a conversation.
invitation.description: Tell us a little about where you are and what you would like to explore.
